verdict.rationale: LM Studio is a local LLM runtime and server (llama.cpp/MLX), so paged KV-cache memory management is a fair question for this kind of product. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions paged attention, KV-cache management, or concurrent-request memory handling. The closest items are context-length and GPU-offload load flags, which are adjacent controls and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rely on paged memory management for attention key/value cache to maximize concurrent request capacity without memory fragmentation
